scene.placeText: the darkened top chamber of the camera obscura tower near the castle gate in her steam city at midday — a brass periscope mirror turning in the domed roof above, a live picture of the misty city, the castle and the rooftops glowing on a great round white table, brass levers and lens rings along the walls
scene.ownProp: a great polished brass lens in an engraved ring, as wide as a dinner plate
scene.outfit: a lens-keeper look fitted to her body — a short fitted jacket with a layered shoulder cape in soft grey and heather-purple tartan, a lace-trimmed corset bodice, a short bustled skirt, a tartan cap at an angle, a brass monocle-lens brooch engraved with a thistle and laced ankle boots

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Scottish woman — the personification of Edinburgh — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Edinburgh as her world knows it — a storybook gaslamp-fantasy city: gleaming brass, polished wood, glass, silk, lace and feathers, clockwork details, warm gaslight and soft white steam — clean, warm and storybook-bright, never sooty, rusty or grimy. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Place: the darkened top chamber of the camera obscura tower near the castle gate in her steam city at midday — a brass periscope mirror turning in the domed roof above, a live picture of the misty city, the castle and the rooftops glowing on a great round white table, brass levers and lens rings along the walls
Outfit: a lens-keeper look fitted to her body — a short fitted jacket with a layered shoulder cape in soft grey and heather-purple tartan, a lace-trimmed corset bodice, a short bustled skirt, a tartan cap at an angle, a brass monocle-lens brooch engraved with a thistle and laced ankle boots, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress of a storybook gaslamp city — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of cotton, fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather, with brass buttons, buckles and hooks, silk ribbons and laced boots, neat and clean.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with both hands she holds a great polished brass lens in an engraved ring, as wide as a dinner plate in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.
Scene note: she is the lens-keeper of the camera obscura, leaning over the round white table with both hands to fit a freshly polished great brass lens back into its ring, the moving picture of the city sliding across the table around her

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a polished brass hand lens on a long telescoping handle — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
